items.example: You can't sleep in your car in some cities.
items.mnemonic: Водитель со сливками спит в машине — sleep in your car.

items.idiom: use your mobile on the flight
items.example: On some airlines you can use your mobile on the flight.
items.mnemonic: Пассажир с флейтой сидит в полёте с телефоном — use mobile on the flight.

items.idiom: travel on the outside of trains
items.example: In Bangladesh passengers travel on the outside of trains.
items.mnemonic: Пассажир висит на сайде поезда — travel on the outside of trains.

items.example: In Japan there are women-only carriages on some trains.
items.mnemonic: Пассажирки с витаминами едут в вагонах only — women-only carriages.

items.idiom: In my country you can't hitchhike
items.translation: В моей стране нельзя ездить автостопом
items.example: In my country you can't hitchhike at all.
items.mnemonic: Ковбой с кантри запрещает автостоп — in my country you can't hitchhike.

items.idiom: put it in a short phrase
items.example: Put a new noun in a short phrase in your notebook.
items.mnemonic: Ученик в шортах пишет короткую фразу — put it in a short phrase.

items.example: Close your book and guess the question.
items.mnemonic: Гусь угадывает вопрос — guess the question.
